items.name: Norwegian Championship 2024
items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2024, for første gang holdt i Sandnes! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).

### Staffing
Vi kommer til å trenge frivillige som kan bidra med ulike oppgaver under arrangementet. De som bidrar på dette teamet vil få ulike goder, blant annet refundert registreringsavgift. Les [Staffing-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) for mer info.

---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2024, held in Sandnes for the first time. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

### Staffing
We are going to need volunteers to help with different tasks during the competition. Those who chose to be a part of this team will get perks such as a refunded registration fee. Read the [Staffing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) tab for more info.

items.name: CubingUSA Southern Championship 2024

venue.name: [Oklahoma City Convention Center](https://okcconventioncenter.com/)
venue.address: 100 Mick Cornett Dr, Oklahoma City, OK 73109

items.information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) as the Southern [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2024.
The following states are eligible for the title of Southern Champion: 

- Arkansas
- Louisiana
- Mississippi
- Oklahoma
- Texas 

All competitors must read the [Important Information/FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2024#36706-important-information-faq) prior to registering.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2024#competition-schedule) is tentative - we may adjust the exact starting time of each event based on the number of registered competitors, however we will not change the scheduled days of any first rounds.

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
